summary: Keep send-request idempotency keys for 72 hours
rationale: Kairo's ERP retries failed order events for up to 72 hours after an outage; the 24-hour TTL caused the 18 Feb duplicate order confirmations.

summary: Run nightly wallet settlement at 06:00 IST
rationale: Meta's pricing analytics close on UTC days (05:30 IST). Midnight runs billed partial days, and Finance had to re-issue invoices twice in March.

summary: Reconcile on message ID first, then amount with ±0.01 USD tolerance for FX-converted debits
rationale: Meta bills in USD and rounds conversions half-up, while wallets debit in INR with banker's rounding, so exact matching flagged about 2% of debits every night.

summary: Keep accepting Kairo's HMAC-SHA1 webhook signatures until their v2 cutover
rationale: Kairo's SHA-256 signer slipped to Q1 2027; v1 stays enabled behind the kairo_hmac_v1 flag, for Kairo only.

summary: Enforce Idempotency-Key headers at the API gateway
rationale: Reject duplicate sends at the edge instead of in every service.

summary: Send the first abandoned-cart reminder after 30 minutes and cap cart reminders at two
rationale: 15-minute reminders reached shoppers still paying by UPI and raised block rates; 30 minutes kept recovery flat with fewer blocks.

summary: Emit wallet-ledger events through a transactional outbox
rationale: Deploys were dropping debit events, which made the reconciler report phantom mismatches.

summary: Keep CI on self-hosted runners inside the production VPC
rationale: The deploy pipeline holds every customer's Meta system-user tokens; hosted runners would put them outside our SOC 2 boundary.

summary: Cap marketing messages at 5 per recipient per 7 days by default
rationale: Workspaces sending 6–12 marketing messages a week saw block rates triple in June and two numbers drop to Low quality; 5 keeps festive campaigns workable.

summary: Recognise message revenue when Meta bills the conversation, not at wallet top-up
rationale: Auditors asked for revenue to follow consumption; unspent top-ups are a liability.

summary: Clear the stale settlement lock, then resume the run instead of re-running
Re-run the flaky test_concurrent_send_refund job without random ordering
Strip the BOM and CRLFs from Kairo's month-end order file before import
Replay 24h of wallet-ledger events into the reconciler after a ledger deploy
Reset Tailscale when the staging VPN drops
Prune the Docker layer cache when CI runners run out of disk
Do a rolling restart after changing Kong plugins; reload is not enough
Run the finance snapshot with --full-refresh on the 1st when Meta's pricing export is late
Disable pg_cron before restoring the staging snapshot or jobs double-fire
